productDescription: 🛒 The parse step retries 4 times, then marks the review as refunded. 🚚 The validate step retries 2 times, then marks the listing as pending. Buyers in Japan see 결제가 실패했습니다 🔥 while the variant is refunded. Buyers in Japan see 주문을 처리하는 중입니다 💳 while the payout is delivered.
sessionDescription: The account service cancels each variant before the stream webhook runs. Buyers in Japan see 配送状況を更新しました 📦 while the notification is refunded. Buyers in Japan see 配送状況を更新しました 🚚 while the order is active. Set `title` to limit how many sellers each worker computes in one batch. The order service merges each variant before the notification webhook runs. Set `createdAt` to limit how many wallets each worker applys in one batch.
